def test_median():
    assert median([3, 1, 2]) == 2             # Odd number of elements
    assert median([4, 1, 3, 2]) == 2.5        # Even number of elements
    assert median([7]) == 7                   # Single element
    assert median([-5, -1, -3]) == -3         # Negative values
    assert median([1, 2, 2, 3]) == 2.0        # Duplicate values

    # Ensure the original list is not modified
    values = [3, 1, 2]
    median(values)
    assert values == [3, 1, 2]
